title: Remove any attached image from the Claude screen's prompt
notes:
An image attached to the prompt (pasted or dropped, chat-attachments.ts) can only be taken off by Backspace in an empty prompt, which drops the last one (chat-view.ts dropLast). There is no way to remove one in the middle, nor to see that Backspace does it.

Change: each thumbnail gets a remove control (an x on hover, top right) that removes that image; keyboard first (conventions-rule-1): a key moves the selection onto the thumbnails from the prompt (e.g. Up from an empty first line, or a chat-scope key in actions.ts), the arrows walk them, Delete or Backspace removes the selected one, Escape goes back to the prompt. Backspace on an empty prompt keeps removing the last. A hover title on a thumbnail says how. Same for whatever else the prompt can attach, if anything (files mentioned with @ are text and stay as they are).

Decision (which image a key removes, where the selection goes after) in a small module with a test (workflow-rule-2). Help row and Claude blurb (keys-rule-2). Docs: chat README, history.
